description: Create a game in the signed-in workspace, or set one up: call this first when asked to set up, add or install Glitchless (or performance monitoring, analytics or telemetry with it) in a game, before changing the game's code. Returns the game's client token (gl_pub_…, the public key game builds send with) and the intake URL to put in the game's Glitchless.init. With engine, or with files (what you find in the game's folder, when you don't know the engine), it also returns the steps that add Glitchless to the game's code for that engine, with the intake URL and client token in them: getting the SDK, privacy, levels and events, the game's own metrics, bug reports, the player's off switch, multiplayer, and checking that data arrives. They are the instrument skill of the Glitchless plugin, for an agent without it, up to 50,000 characters. Give name for a new game or game for one already in the workspace; with neither, the steps say how to get a client token, and when files name no engine nothing is made and the answer says what to look for. On a server with no workspace (the open-source server), the steps name that server. A name that's already in the workspace returns that game, not a second one. Later calls can name it with game. With demo: true it makes the demo game instead: Zoomies with a week of sample play (findings, levels, errors, sessions and a dashboard), for trying every tool before a real game sends data. A workspace has one demo game, and it takes no room from the plan's games. With rename (and game naming which one), renames a game instead, as players know it (a jam game renamed before release): the dashboard, share links and emails show the new name, and its client token, its service (what the game sends as service in Glitchless.init) and its data stay as they are, so the game's code needn't change. Later calls name it by its new name. Ask the person before renaming their game. With delete (the game's name, repeated back as the person confirmed it, and game naming which one), deletes the game and everything Glitchless keeps for it: its data, dashboard, bug reports, keys, share links, alerts and store connections. It can't be undone. It needs a connection the person gave "Delete games and their data, for good", which is off unless they ticked it (a new key in Settings → Keys & access, or connecting again), and whose person is an Owner or Admin. When two games in the workspace share the name, nothing is deleted and the answer lists them (id, when made, whether they have data): ask the person which one, then call again with game set to its id. The game is gone from the workspace at once and frees its place in the plan; its client token is refused from then on; it's gone from Glitchless within the hour, and backups, including old copies of its files, keep it up to 35 more days. Only delete when the person asked for it in so many words, after telling them all of this.

delete.description: Instead of making a game: delete the game that game names (by its id when two games share the name), for good. The game's name again, as the person confirmed it, any case

demo.description: Make the demo game, with a week of sample play

engine.description: Also return the steps that add Glitchless to the game's code, for its engine: unity, godot, unreal, threejs (React Three Fiber too), roblox, phaser, babylon, playcanvas or gamemaker; reddit for a game in a Reddit post (with files: ["devvit.json"] and the engine of the game in it, Reddit's steps and that engine's come together)

files.description: Or, when you don't know the engine: what you find in the game's folder, which names it. File names at its root (project.godot, MyGame.uproject, Game.yyp, ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt, default.project.json, devvit.json for a game in a Reddit post, package.json) and package.json dependencies (three, phaser, @babylonjs/core, playcanvas)

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. With a key for one game (gl_sk_…), a call that names another game is refused: sign in to the workspace to reach every game.

name.description: The game's name, as players know it (not needed with demo). One already in the workspace is returned, not made again

rename.description: Instead of making a game: the new name (60 characters at most) of the game that game names

name: glitchless_create_game
title: Create, set up, rename or delete game
